semiconductor_relevance: High — Sanying MotionControl Instruments Ltd specializes in precision motion control technology essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Sanying Precision Control (Tianjin) Instrument Equipment Co., Ltd. develops advanced precision motion control systems tailored for the semiconductor industry. Their products include high-precision motion platforms and nanoscale sensors, addressing the stringent requirements for accuracy and reliability in semiconductor inspection and measurement.

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Tianjin, China, focusing on the development and manufacturing of precision control instruments.
